title: Create Report
description:
Create a basic (standard) report in Intel Exchange.



> [!NOTE]
> Do not use this endpoint to create advanced reports.

query.name: type
query.description: Pass the type of report to be created.

body.name: name
body.description: Pass the name of the report.

body.name: type
body.description: Pass the type of report to be created.

body.name: basic_report_type
body.description: Pass the type of basic report to be created.

body.name: shared_type
body.description: Pass the share type value.

body.name: saved_search
body.description: Pass the saved search or custom query details used for generating the report. You can use the List Saved Search endpoint to retrieve the required details.

items.name: meta_data
items.description: Pass the saved search metadata to include in the report.

items.name: name
items.description: Pass the saved search name.

items.name: query
items.description: Pass the saved search query to generate the report.

body.name: schedule
body.description: Pass the schedule details such as repeat type, start date and time, duration time, duration value, and repeat value.

items.name: repeat_type
items.description: Pass the frequency of the schedule.

items.name: start_datetime
items.description: Pass the start time of the report in epoch format.

items.name: duration_value
items.description: Pass the time frame in days to include the data in the report.

items.name: repeat_value
items.description: Pass the number of times to repeat the schedule.

body.name: file_types
body.description: Pass the report type.

items.description: Pass the report type, such as CSV, XLS.

body.name: columns
body.description: Pass the list of columns to be displayed in a basic report.

items.name: key
items.description: Pass the report column key.

items.name: label
items.description: Pass the report column label.

body.name: internal_recipients
body.description: Pass the list of internal recipients with whom to share the report.

items.name: to
items.description: Pass details of the internal recipient of the report.

items.name: user_id
items.description: Enter the user ID.

items.name: first_name

items.name: last_name

items.name: email
items.description: Enter the email address.

items.name: cc
items.description: Enter the cc email addresses for the internal recipients

items.name: bcc
items.description: Enter the bcc email addresses for the internal recipients

body.description: Pass the key to sort data in the report.
